name: Villarta (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red with a green triangle at the hoist.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 25 October 2011 (Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha no. 226 of 18 November 2011); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal horizontal stripes, white above and red below, with a triangle at the hoist.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
